items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, and Rose Cassard sang too... [INTERVIEWEE] She can sing too, man.

ctx.x: I was the only guy in the band with eight women in the family. A lot of music in the family.
Oh, and Rose Cassard sang too. That's old Joe Cassard, his daughter sang. There's a lot of music in the family.
